notablePrerequisites: Spawning Pit has at least two charge counters on it.
description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating three 2/2 Spawn artifact creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a Spawn, adding {R}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing two Spawns, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.
